When unknown tradeoffs prevent a justified preference, use tie for a supported comparable fit or insufficient for uncertainty that prevents comparison. Candidate position must never be a preference factor. Return JSON only with label, rationale, evidence_A, evidence_B, uncertainties, and salary_comparison_choice. Rationale is one short sentence of at most 240 characters.
